# Logic Clothes — full LLM context

Brand: Logic Clothes
Founded: 2015
Category: Ukrainian author womenswear
HQ / store: Sofiivska 5, Kyiv, Ukraine (Concept store)
Web: https://logicclothes.ua
Default locale: uk (Ukrainian); also en (English)
Canonical pattern: https://logicclothes.ua/{lang}/{path}
Product URL pattern: https://logicclothes.ua/{lang}/product/{id}
Catalog filters: https://logicclothes.ua/{lang}/catalog?category={categoryId}

## Positioning
Logic Clothes is an author brand, not a high-street chain. Colour and print are central.
There are no traditional seasonal collections — pieces appear as a continuous creative stream.
The audience is creative, tech-fluent, and generally uninterested in mass-market basics.
Size range is intentionally open; custom colour, print, and sizing are part of the offer.
The physical store and Instagram are presented as a “treasure shop”: dense, curious, not Zara-like.
